summary: Orla Mining Ltd. filed a 6-K reporting receipt of an interim order and mailing of meeting materials for a special shareholder meeting to approve its acquisition by Equinox Gold Corp. Under the arrangement, each Orla share will be exchanged for 1.00 Equinox share plus US$0.0001 cash. Former Orla shareholders will own ~33% of the combined company, while Equinox shareholders will own ~67% on a fully-diluted in-the-money basis. The board unanimously recommends voting FOR. The meeting is set for July 22, 2026, with a final court order expected around July 28, 2026. A no action letter from the Competition Commissioner has been received, clearing the Canadian competition review. The transaction is structured as a court-approved plan of arrangement under Canadian law. Watch for shareholder approval and the final court order to close the deal.
